description: Hand-verified capability inventory for RadioDroid (net.programmierecke.radiodroid2), version 0.86.

features.name: Browse popular radio stations
features.description: Browse popular radio stations as documented for RadioDroid.
actions: switch between the sub-lists (for example most popular/top clicked, top voted, trending/recently clicked and recently changed)
tap a station to play it

features.name: Search for a station by name
features.description: Search for a station by name as documented for RadioDroid.
actions: Tap the search icon in the toolbar
tap a result to play it

features.name: Search stations by tag, country, language or state
features.description: Search stations by tag, country, language or state as documented for RadioDroid.
actions: choose the tag, country, state, language, codec or minimum bitrate criteria

features.name: Play a station
features.description: Play a station as documented for RadioDroid.
actions: Tap the station in any list
playback starts and the player bar appears at the bottom
tap the bar to expand the full player

features.name: Stop playback
features.description: Stop playback as documented for RadioDroid.
actions: Tap the stop control in the player bar, the expanded player or the notification

features.name: Add a station to favourites
features.description: Add a station to favourites as documented for RadioDroid.
actions: Long-press the station in a list (or open its detail page)
tap the star/"Add to favourites" action; the station appears in the Favourites/Starred screen

features.name: Remove a station from favourites
features.description: Remove a station from favourites as documented for RadioDroid.

features.name: Reorder favourite stations
features.description: Reorder favourite stations as documented for RadioDroid.
actions: drag it to the new position

features.name: View station details
features.description: View station details as documented for RadioDroid.
actions: read the bitrate, codec, country, language, tags, click and vote counts, and the homepage link

features.name: Vote for a station
features.description: Vote for a station as documented for RadioDroid.
actions: tap the vote/thumbs-up action; the vote is sent to the radio-browser directory

features.name: Open a station's homepage
features.description: Open a station's homepage as documented for RadioDroid.
actions: the page opens in the browser

features.name: Share a station
features.description: Share a station as documented for RadioDroid.
actions: Long-press the station (or open its detail page)
choose whether to share the stream URL or the station page

features.name: Record the stream to a file
features.description: Record the stream to a file as documented for RadioDroid.
actions: tap the record button in the player (or the overflow menu
the stream is written to the configured recordings folder
tap the record button again to stop

features.name: Browse and play saved recordings
features.description: Browse and play saved recordings as documented for RadioDroid.
actions: tap a recording to play it
long-press to rename, share or delete it

features.name: View the played-track history
features.description: View the played-track history as documented for RadioDroid.
actions: review the songs reported by the stations you have listened to
tap an entry to search for it

features.name: Set a sleep timer
features.description: Set a sleep timer as documented for RadioDroid.
actions: Open the expanded player or the overflow menu
confirm; playback stops when the timer runs out

features.name: Set a radio alarm clock
features.description: Set a radio alarm clock as documented for RadioDroid.
actions: select the station to wake up to

features.name: Enable, edit or delete an alarm
features.description: Enable, edit or delete an alarm as documented for RadioDroid.
actions: toggle the switch to enable or disable an alarm
tap it to change the time, station or repeat days

features.name: Import favourite stations from an M3U file
features.description: Import favourite stations from an M3U file as documented for RadioDroid.
actions: Open the navigation drawer or the Favourites overflow menu
confirm; the stations are added to the favourites

features.name: Export favourite stations to an M3U file
features.description: Export favourite stations to an M3U file as documented for RadioDroid.

features.name: Cast a station to a Chromecast device
features.description: Cast a station to a Chromecast device as documented for RadioDroid.
actions: Ensure the phone and the Chromecast are on the same network
tap the cast icon in the toolbar

features.name: Send playback to an MPD server
features.description: Send playback to an MPD server as documented for RadioDroid.
actions: add the server address and port
then use the MPD action in the player or the overflow menu to send the current station to that server

features.name: Control playback from the notification
features.description: Control playback from the notification as documented for RadioDroid.
actions: use the play/stop and record controls displayed there

features.name: Choose the media player engine
features.description: Choose the media player engine as documented for RadioDroid.
actions: choose between the system MediaPlayer and ExoPlayer

features.name: Adjust the streaming buffer and resume behaviour

features.name: Set the recordings folder and naming
features.description: Set the recordings folder and naming as documented for RadioDroid.

features.name: Restrict playback or downloads to Wi-Fi
features.description: Restrict playback or downloads to Wi-Fi as documented for RadioDroid.

features.name: Change the theme
features.description: Change the theme as documented for RadioDroid.
actions: choose the light, dark or black theme

features.name: Change the station list layout and icon display
features.description: Change the station list layout and icon display as documented for RadioDroid.
actions: toggle whether station icons are loaded, and choose the list or grid layout

features.name: Select the radio-browser server or mirror
features.description: Select the radio-browser server or mirror as documented for RadioDroid.
actions: choose the automatic server selection or enter a specific radio-browser mirror

features.name: Add the home screen shortcut for a station
features.description: Add the home screen shortcut for a station as documented for RadioDroid.
actions: confirm the placement on the Android home screen

actions: read the version, the credits, the licence and the radio-browser attribution
